house.page.rules: How points and the stake work
house.page.rulesPointsBody: A John done on time earns its points. A late one earns half, and a missed one earns nothing. The Table adds them up for the week and the month.
house.page.rulesStakeBody: Everyone puts in {stake} a month. A late John costs {late} and a missed one {missed}, but nobody loses more than {stake} in a month. On the 1st, what was forfeited is split among everyone else. Jonz never moves money: pay each other however you like, and whoever is paid marks it received.
house.page.rulesImmunityBody: Every {every} clean weeks in a row earns a skip (you can hold {cap}). Use one on any John and there’s no forfeit.
house.page.rulesSwapBody: Top the week and you earn a swap: swap one of your open Johns for someone else’s that week.
house.page.rulesSharesBody: Johns are dealt so that everyone does their share, counted from the day they joined. What counts is what you did: a missed John comes back to you, and one you cover for someone counts as yours. Whoever is behind is dealt a little more, never more than half as much again. A group’s Johns are evened out within the group, apart from the rest of the house’s. Time away is made up {makeup}.
